25/* @brief Geometry used to flatten a tactile spherical cap into a rectangle. */
26enum class TactileRectProjectionType {
27 AzimuthalEqualArea = 1,
28 AzimuthalEquidistant = 2,
29 Octahedral = 3,
30};
31
32/* @brief Resampling from projected taxels into the output grid. */
33enum class TactileRectRasterizationType {
34 /* Distribute every taxel's force across its discrete projected Voronoi region. */
35 ConservativeVoronoi = 1,
36
37 /* Accumulate every taxel's complete force into its nearest output cell. */
38 NearestCell = 2,
39};
40
41/* @brief Handling for source taxels outside a configured tactile spherical cap. */
42enum class TactileRectOutsidePolicy {
43 Reject = 1,
44 Exclude = 2,
45};
46
47/* @brief Ordered, sensor-link-frame positions for a tactile taxel layout.
48 * The position order is the taxel identity. */
49struct TactileTaxelLayout {
50 /* Taxel positions [m] in the sensor link frame. */
51 DynamicArray<Real3> positions;
52};

54/* @brief Dense taxel-force observation for one tactile site. */
55struct TactileTaxelForces {
56 /* One force [N] per layout taxel, in the sensor link frame. */
57 DynamicArray<Real3> forces;
58};

61MOCHI_API void FlattenTactileTaxelForcesInto(

66/* @brief Force-only aggregation for one tactile site. */
67struct TactileAggregateForce {
68 /* Sum of the taxel forces [N], in the sensor link frame. */
69 Real3 force = {};
70};
71
72/* @brief Force-and-torque aggregation for one tactile site. */
73struct TactileAggregateWrench {
74 /* Sum of the taxel forces [N], in the sensor link frame. */
75 Real3 force = {};
76
77 /* Sum of position cross force about @ref referencePoint [N*m], in the sensor link frame. */
78 Real3 torque = {};
79
80 /* Point about which @ref torque is resolved [m], in the sensor link frame. */
81 Real3 referencePoint = {};
82};

84/* @brief Configuration for mapping a tactile spherical cap to a rectangle. */
85struct TactileHemisphereRectParams {
86 /* Hemisphere center [m] in the sensor link frame. */
87 Real3 center = {};
88
89 /* Direction from @ref center to the tactile tip. It is normalized by the mapper. */
90 Real3 tipDirection{0_r, 0_r, 1_r};
91
92 /* Direction assigned longitude zero. Its component along @ref tipDirection is removed. */
93 Real3 zeroLongitudeDirection{1_r, 0_r, 0_r};
94
95 /* Number of rectangular grid columns. */
96 int32_t width = 0;
97
98 /* Number of rectangular grid rows. */
99 int32_t height = 0;
100
101 /* Largest selected polar angle [rad]. Pi/2 describes a hemisphere. */
102 real maxPolarLatitude = 1.5707963267948966_r;
103
104 /* Spherical-cap flattening geometry. */
105 TactileRectProjectionType projection = TactileRectProjectionType::AzimuthalEqualArea;
106
107 /* Force-conserving resampling from projected taxels into grid cells. */
108 TactileRectRasterizationType rasterization = TactileRectRasterizationType::ConservativeVoronoi;
109
110 /* Linear fine-grid scale used to resolve discrete Voronoi regions before output downsampling. */
111 int32_t voronoiOversampling = 4;
112
113 /* Whether source taxels beyond @ref maxPolarLatitude are rejected or explicitly excluded. */
114 TactileRectOutsidePolicy outsidePolicy = TactileRectOutsidePolicy::Reject;
115};
116
117/* @brief Resolved, immutable mapping from a taxel layout to a rectangular grid. */
118struct TactileRectProjectionMap {
119 /* Normalized rectangular coordinates in [-1, 1], one per source taxel. */
120 DynamicArray<Real2> coordinates;
121
122 /* Row-major destination cell per source taxel, or -1 when explicitly excluded. */
123 DynamicArray<int32_t> taxelCells;
124
125 /* CSR offsets into @ref contributionCells and @ref contributionWeights, one row per taxel. */
126 DynamicArray<int32_t> taxelContributionOffsets;
127
128 /* Row-major destination cells receiving force from each taxel. */
129 DynamicArray<int32_t> contributionCells;
130
131 /* Per-taxel force fractions. Every selected taxel's CSR row sums to one. */
132 DynamicArray<real> contributionWeights;
133
134 /* Number of grid columns. */
135 int32_t width = 0;
136
137 /* Number of grid rows. */
138 int32_t height = 0;
139
140 /* Number of source taxels selected by the projection. */
141 int32_t selectedTaxelCount = 0;
142
143 /* Resampling used to build the contribution matrix. */
144 TactileRectRasterizationType rasterization = TactileRectRasterizationType::ConservativeVoronoi;
145
146 /* Fine-grid scale used for conservative Voronoi resampling, or one for nearest-cell mode. */
147 int32_t voronoiOversampling = 1;
148};
149
150/* @brief Rectangular tactile force grid for one site. */
151struct TactileForceGrid {
152 /* Row-major cell force sums [N] in the sensor link frame. */
153 DynamicArray<Real3> forces;
154
155 /* Number of source taxels making a nonzero contribution to each row-major cell. */
156 DynamicArray<int32_t> taxelCounts;
157
158 /* Number of grid columns. */
159 int32_t width = 0;
160
161 /* Number of grid rows. */
162 int32_t height = 0;
163};

173/* @brief Convert a sparse node-force query into a dense taxel-force observation.

175 * @param nodeForces Sparse force records [N] in world frame. Repeated indices are accumulated.
176 * @param worldFromSensor Sensor-link pose in world space.
177 * @param layout Ordered taxel layout that defines the output shape and identity.
178 * @param error Error status. Out-of-range indices and non-finite forces are rejected.

195/* @brief Read a dense taxel-force observation from a Mochi actor.
196 *
197 * The caller must register @ref QueryType::NodeContactForces before stepping the scene and keep
198 * that query registered while reading. This function deliberately does not own query lifetime, so
199 * applications can share one registration across multiple consumers.
200 *
201 * @param actor Actor whose node-force query is read.
202 * @param worldFromSensor Sensor-frame pose in world space. Pass the actor root transform when the
203 * actor and sensor frames coincide.
204 * @param layout Ordered taxel layout matching the actor's node indices.
205 * @param error Error status.
206 * @return One sensor-link-frame force per layout taxel, or an empty observation on error. */
207MOCHI_API TactileTaxelForces ReadTactileTaxelForces(
208 Actor const* actor,
209 TransformRT const& worldFromSensor,
210 TactileTaxelLayout const& layout,
211 superdex::Error& error);

230AggregateTactileForce(TactileTaxelForces const& taxelForces, superdex::Error& error);

232/* @brief Aggregate taxel forces into a wrench about @p referencePoint.
233 *
234 * @param layout Ordered taxel positions in the sensor link frame.
235 * @param taxelForces Taxel forces indexed by @p layout.
236 * @param referencePoint Torque reference point [m] in the sensor link frame.
237 * @param error Error status. Mismatched layouts and non-finite inputs are rejected.
238 * @return Aggregated force and torque. */
239MOCHI_API TactileAggregateWrench AggregateTactileWrench(

245/* @brief Resolve a tactile spherical-cap layout into a rectangular projection.
246 *
247 * Every projection places the tactile tip at continuous coordinate (0, 0), halfway between the four
248 * central cells of an even-sized grid. Nearest-cell rasterization deterministically resolves that
249 * tie toward the larger row and column. Taxels outside the configured spherical cap are either
250 * rejected or assigned cell -1 according to @ref TactileHemisphereRectParams::outsidePolicy.
251 *
252 * @param layout Ordered taxel positions in the sensor link frame.
253 * @param params Hemisphere frame and output grid shape.
254 * @param error Error status. Invalid frames, mismatched layouts and positions outside the requested
255 * cap under the reject policy are rejected.
256 * @return Stable continuous coordinates, nearest cells and a force-conserving contribution map. */
257MOCHI_API TactileRectProjectionMap BuildTactileRectProjection(
258 TactileTaxelLayout const& layout,
259 TactileHemisphereRectParams const& params,
260 superdex::Error& error);
261
262/* @brief Rasterize taxel forces through a resolved tactile projection.
263 *
264 * Every selected taxel's contribution weights sum to one, so the grid force sum equals the
265 * selected input force sum for either rasterization mode.
266 *
267 * @param projection Resolved mapping built for the source layout.
268 * @param taxelForces Taxel forces indexed by that layout.
269 * @param error Error status. Mismatched layouts and non-finite forces are rejected.
270 * @return Row-major rectangular force grid and per-cell taxel counts. */
271MOCHI_API TactileForceGrid RasterizeTactileRectProjection(
272 TactileRectProjectionMap const& projection,
273 TactileTaxelForces const& taxelForces,
274 superdex::Error& error);
275
276/* @brief Rasterize through a resolved projection without allocating.
277 * @p out forces and taxel counts must each contain width times height elements. */
278MOCHI_API void RasterizeTactileRectProjectionInto(
279 TactileRectProjectionMap const& projection,
280 TactileTaxelForces const& taxelForces,
281 TactileForceGrid& out,
282 superdex::Error& error);
283
284/* @brief Resolve and rasterize a taxel-force observation in one call.

286 * Prefer caching @ref BuildTactileRectProjection when mapping repeated frames from one layout.
287 */
288MOCHI_API TactileForceGrid MapTactileHemisphereToRect(
289 TactileTaxelLayout const& layout,
290 TactileTaxelForces const& taxelForces,
291 TactileHemisphereRectParams const& params,
292 superdex::Error& error);

294/* @brief Compatibility wrapper that resolves and rasterizes into a pre-sized rectangular grid.
295 *
296 * @deprecated This function rebuilds and allocates the projection on every call. Repeated-frame
297 * callers should cache @ref BuildTactileRectProjection and call @ref

299 * @p out forces and taxel counts must each contain width times height elements. */
300[[deprecated("Cache BuildTactileRectProjection and call RasterizeTactileRectProjectionInto")]]
301MOCHI_API void MapTactileHemisphereToRectInto(
302 TactileTaxelLayout const& layout,
303 TactileTaxelForces const& taxelForces,
